reason: 该插件的主要用途是增强 DSH Web 的会话管理体验：在设置页与会话页入口集中展示并操作会话列表、回收站、归档、继续/暂停、统计及日志目录入口，并提供会话分组与上下文压缩阈值设置，因此归类为界面导航面板类插件。其功能包含可恢复/可清理的会话删除流程与本地持久化状态，具有可观察但可控的数据变更风险。

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DSH Web 的会话管理插件，可在会话列表和侧边抽屉中集中进行回收站恢复、删除、继续/暂停、统计查看、分组排序及日志目录访问等会话操作。
summaries.en: This is a DSH Web session manager plugin that lets users handle sessions from dedicated UI panels with trash restore, delete, continue/pause, stats, workspace grouping/sorting, log-folder access, and unread state actions.

capabilities: Delete sessions to a trash list with restore and purge options
Pause active sessions and mark unread/read states in the session list
Open session log folders from the interface
Persist trash and workspace/session management data through host/client state
Configure a global context compaction threshold used by agent presets
